About this product

Acconet Rackmount UPS SNMP Module with UPS Remote Control is an accessory designed to enhance the functionality of Acconet rackmount UPS systems. This module enables Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) capabilities, allowing for remote monitoring and management of the UPS via network interfaces. Users can access real-time status updates, manage power settings, and receive alerts for any issues, ensuring optimal performance and reliability of connected equipment.
